summary: Two rings: once a day, one wearer's area spell spares the other (an automatic success, no damage instead of half).
text: These rings come as a pair. When one wearer casts a spell with an area that calls for saving throws, the other wearer in the area automatically succeeds and takes no damage if it would have taken half on a success. The pair shares one use per dawn, and destroying either ring destroys both.

powers.name: Companion's Shield
powers.text: Used on its own when your companion's area spell catches you.
